reason: Hodgson left West Brom in May 2012 to become England manager ahead of Euro 2012; Steve Clarke was appointed his successor in June 2012. Distractors are all plausible manager jobs, none is the club itself.
Jonny Evans signed for West Brom in summer 2015 from Manchester United after nine years at Old Trafford, for a reported £6m. Fact checks out cleanly.

Derby beat West Brom 1-0 in the 2007 Championship play-off final via a Stephen Pearson goal; West Brom had beaten Wolves in the semi-final (first leg 13 May, final 28 May — a fortnight is accurate). No false premise.
Mowbray, appointed October 2006, won the Championship title with West Brom in 2007-08 and reached the FA Cup semi-final the same season. Confirmed.

Di Matteo took West Brom up as Championship runners-up (behind Newcastle) in 2009-10 after the 2008-09 relegation under Mowbray, and was sacked in February 2011 (after a 3-0 loss to Man City) despite the promotion. Both stem and hint check out.
Steve Clarke's 2012-13 West Brom finished 8th with a club-record 49 points — still their best-ever Premier League finish. Confirmed.
Lukaku, on loan from Chelsea, scored a second-half hat-trick as West Brom drew 5-5 with Manchester United in Ferguson's final match, May 2013 — well-documented.

Stem and keyed answer are correct — Odemwingie joined West Brom in August 2010 from Lokomotiv Moscow for a reported £2.5m, scoring 15 league goals that season. But the hint's 'his first season back in England' is a false premise: before West Brom, Odemwingie's career ran Bendel Insurance (Nigeria) -> La Louvière (Belgium) -> Lille (France) -> Lokomotiv Moscow (Russia). He had never played club football in England before 2010, so it was his first season IN England, not a return.

fixed.q: Peter Odemwingie joined West Brom in August 2010 from which club?
fixed.hint: The Nigeria forward arrived from Lokomotiv for a reported £2.5m and scored 15 league goals in his first season in England.
